'''Rennek''' was the capital of the [[Dark Worlds]].<ref name="JC2015" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2015]] novella, ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]'' established the [[Dark Worlds]] as being an [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] principality, located at the furthest reaches of the galaxy as well as mentioning [[Rennek palace]], deep within the Dark Worlds.<ref name="SkyeWalkers" /> In addressing fan-commentary on both ''[[The Epic Continues]]''' [[Atha Prime/Legends|Atha Prime]] and ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]'s'' [[Zeta Magnus]]' connection to the [[Dark Worlds]], Abel G. Peña acknowledged that Rennek was ''their capital''. Peña also remarked that "Rennek", [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] spelled backwards, was previously "Orbsah", which is [[Hasbro]] spelled backwards.<ref name="JC2015" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', has indicated that he is aware of Rennek, but that its placement is yet to be determined.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023 4.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-10-22}}</ref>
